description: Source file implementing the TunDeviceController class for managing network interface addresses and routes on a Raspberry Pi 4, including route updates, rule management, and address change callbacks.

classes.name: TunDeviceController
classes.description: Controller class for managing network interface addresses, routes, and rules on a Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: UpdateAddress
methods.description: Updates the IP address of the network interface to a desired range, removing old addresses and setting a new one.

methods.name: UpdateRoutes
methods.description: Updates network routes and rules based on desired IP ranges and route configurations.

methods.name: UpdateRoutesWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to update routes multiple times with delays between retries.

methods.name: UpdateRules
methods.description: Replaces default routing rules with desired rules for the network interface.

methods.name: current_address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address of the interface.

methods.name: RegisterAddressUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called when the address is updated.
